_note: Real Rivanna job photos are self-hosted under assets/images/. Paths are relative to the site root. Team portraits were removed because there are no real staff photos. Carpet and upholstery still use generic stock with no faces, kept so those layouts still have a photo. Post-construction, janitorial, office, and commercial used stock photos of people, so those slots now use brand-mark.svg until a real job photo exists. The homepage before/after section uses the raw before-kitchen and after-kitchen pair. ba-split-kitchen, ba-split-jet-tub, and accent-shower-detail are self-hosted and not placed in a page. accent-cooktop was not published because a face is reflected in the microwave door.
